results.question: 结合 KGP 和 CuriousLLM 原文，后者针对前者提出了什么增强？把多文档图、遍历代理、后续问题及其监督信号串起来，并区分作者评价与已验证事实。
results.answer: CuriousLLM 针对 KGP 的增强被作者表述为将“好奇心驱动的推理机制”集成进 LLM 代理，使代理生成相关后续问题以引导检索 [chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。在多文档图方面，KGP 原文构建的 KG 以节点表示段落或文档结构、边表示词法/语义相似度或文档内结构关系，并设计了基于 LLM 的 KG 遍历代理交替进行证据生成与邻居选择 [chunk_4c2f9284ed69432f1dd6ad5217a9a783]。CuriousLLM 在此遍历代理环节将其作为“图遍历代理”来增强 KGP 框架，并以 Bob 与 Mariaan 年龄的例子说明后续问题可在语义不相似的段落间建立逻辑联系 [chunk_9f06285c9b321c365675a3b670256a07]。监督信号方面，作者称开发了 Follow-upQA 数据集，包含问题与支持证据作为输入、后续问题作为 ground truth，后续问题或询问尚缺什么，或用特殊 token 表示检索证据已足够 [chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]；作者还称训练 LLM 代理判断何时结束搜索，早停机制降低原 T5 代理的延迟 [chunk_9f06285c9b321c365675a3b670256a07]。作者主张 CuriousLLM 提升 MD-QA 表现并规避原 KGP 的大量计算成本与延迟，以及无需大量微调 [chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f][chunk_f783bd933d0d2a437496939e022a776a]；这些是作者评价，证据中未给出可核验的具体实验协议与数字。

results.question: 结合 KGP 和 CuriousLLM 原文，后者针对前者提出了什么增强？把多文档图、遍历代理、后续问题及其监督信号串起来，并区分作者评价与已验证事实。
results.answer: CuriousLLM 作者称其“an enhancement that integrates a curiosity-driven reasoning mechanism into an LLM agent”，使该代理生成相关后续问题来引导信息检索 [chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]；针对 KGP 需昂贵微调且易幻觉的问题，作者主张该机制通过后续问题更高效地引导检索 [chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。多文档图与遍历代理方面，KGP 原文的方法是“construct a KG over the given documents”，并设计“an LLM-based KG traversal agent”交替生成证据与选择邻居 [chunk_4c2f9284ed69432f1dd6ad5217a9a783]；CuriousLLM 成文证据仅称其作为图遍历代理增强 KGP 框架 [chunk_9f06285c9b321c365675a3b670256a07]，未在给定引句中完整重述同一图构建流程。后续问题与监督信号方面，作者称开发 Follow-upQA 数据集，包含问题与支持证据为输入、后续问题为真值，后续问题询问仍缺什么或以特殊标记表示证据充分 [chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]；并称训练代理判断何时结束搜索，从而降低原 T5 代理的延迟 [chunk_9f06285c9b321c365675a3b670256a07]。已验证事实限于作者报告的实验结果，且所给引句未提供可核对的数值：作者称实验显示 CuriousLLM 显著提升多文档问答表现并规避原 KGP 的大量计算成本与延迟 [chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]，并称需全面实验结果与消融研究支持其性能、效率及微调后推理能力提升 [chunk_f783bd933d0d2a437496939e022a776a]。因此，“无需大量微调”“更高效精确”“降低延迟”和“显著提升”均为作者主张或作者报告的结果，而非本证据中独立验证的事实；也缺少与 KGP 在数据划分、底座模型、指标和协议上的可比信息，不能据同一多文档问答任务推断公平胜负或继承关系。

results.answer: StructGPT 在回答时通过为结构化数据设计的接口逐步获取证据：其 IRR 框架把“收集相关证据（reading）”与“推理/规划后续步骤（reasoning）”作为两项主要功能，并通过迭代调用接口逐步接近目标答案 [chunk_9f421de75aed07b68340cb2f2471a79e]。LPKG 在训练时获得规划数据的方式，按方法概述是在“数据构建步骤”中从知识图谱构建规划数据，并定义了一些基本 KG 模式 [chunk_73bc55c51e0886e7dda37a98fe4fe0cb]；其结果部分也提到使用“KG-sourced planning data”微调模型以提升规划能力 [chunk_bca043f33502bdedb273cd4b0ffe1769]。关于 KG/结构化数据的角色差异：StructGPT 把多类结构化数据视为黑盒系统，接口用于为 LLM 提供准确高效的数据访问与过滤，LLM 基于从接口获得的证据进行推理 [chunk_9f421de75aed07b68340cb2f2471a79e]；LPKG 则把 KG 用作训练规划数据的来源 [chunk_73bc55c51e0886e7dda37a98fe4fe0cb][chunk_bca043f33502bdedb273cd4b0ffe1769]。需说明：所给 LPKG 方法段仅概述“从 KG 构建规划数据”，未展开具体构建流程；因此其训练数据构建的细节证据不足。

improving the zero-shot reasoning ability of LLMs
over structured data, namely StructGPT. In our ap-
proach, we first constructed the specialized inter-
faces that support accurate and efficient data ac-
cess, and then proposed an invoking-linearization-
generation procedure that leverages LLMs to read
and perform reasoning based on the interface. By
iterating the above procedure using the interfaces
sequentially, LLMs can progressively capture more
useful and detailed evidence and finally generate

analysis to point out the weakness of our approach,

evidence.title: KG-GPT: A General Framework for Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs Using Large Language Models
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/181_KG-GPT A General Framework for Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs Using Large Language Models.pdf
evidence.quote:
To this end, we propose a new general frame-
work, called KG-GPT, that uses LLMs’ reasoning
capabilities to perform KG-based tasks. KG-GPT
is similar to StructGPT (Jiang et al., 2023) in that
both reason on structured data using LLMs. How-
ever, unlike StructGPT which identifies paths from
a seed entity to the final answer entity within KGs,
KG-GPT retrieves the entire sub-graph and then
infers the answer. This means KG-GPT can be
used not only for KGQA but also for tasks like
KG-based fact verification.
KG-GPT consists of three steps: 1) Sentence
(Claim / Question) Segmentation, 2) Graph Re-
trieval, and 3) Inference. During Sentence Seg-
mentation, a sentence is partitioned into discrete
sub-sentences, each aligned with a single triple (i.e.
[head, relation, tail]). The subsequent step, namely
Graph Retrieval, retrieves a potential pool of rela-
tions that could bridge the entities identified within
the sub-sentences. Then, a candidate pool of evi-
dence graphs (i.e. sub-KG) is obtained using the
retrieved relations and the entity set. In the final
step, the obtained graphs are used to derive a logi-
cal conclusion, such as validating a given claim or
answering a given question.
To evaluate KG-GPT, we employ KG-based
fact verification and KGQA benchmarks, both de-
manding complex reasoning that utilizes structured
knowledge of KGs. In KG-based fact verification,
we use FACTKG (Kim et al., 2023), which includes

Conclusion
We suggest KG-GPT, a versatile framework that
utilizes LLMs for tasks that use KGs. KG-GPT is
divided into three stages: Sentence Segmentation,
Graph Retrieval, and Inference, each designed for
breaking down sentences, sourcing related graph
elements, and reaching reasoned outcomes, respec-
tively. We assess KG-GPT’s efficacy using KG-
based fact verification and KGQA metrics, and
the model demonstrates consistent, impressive re-
sults, even surpassing a number of fully-supervised
models. Consequently, our research signifies a sub-
stantial advancement in combining structured and
unstructured data management in the LLMs’ con-
text.

Finally, we conduct
testing on our benchmark CLQA-Wiki.

results.question: ToG 和 RoG 都利用 KG 推理，为什么不能据此把两者都归为免训练方法？分别追踪 KG 在在线搜索和训练中的作用。
results.answer: ToG 的在线 KG 作用是：LLM 作为 agent 在 KG 上迭代执行 beam search、发现推理路径并给出结果，且原文把 ToG 定位为 training-free 的 prompting 方法。[chunk_e09b5a88c34014513aad6c0d6121f790][chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2] RoG 的 KG 作用不是仅在推理时在线探索：它先生成由 KG 接地的关系路径作为计划，再由检索-推理模块从 KG 检索有效推理路径进行推理，并通过规划优化和检索-推理优化两个任务训练 LLM。[chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21] 因此，把两者都归为免训练方法不成立：有直接证据表明 ToG 是 training-free，而 RoG 的描述包含对 LLM 的训练/优化任务；关于 RoG 是否另有免训练在线阶段，所给证据不足以判定。[chunk_e09b5a88c34014513aad6c0d6121f790][chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21]

ABSTRACT
Although large language models (LLMs) have achieved significant success in vari-
ous tasks, they often struggle with hallucination problems, especially in scenarios
requiring deep and responsible reasoning. These issues could be partially addressed
by introducing external knowledge graphs (KG) in LLM reasoning. In this paper,
we propose a new LLM-KG integrating paradigm “LLM ⊗KG” which treats the
LLM as an agent to interactively explore related entities and relations on KGs
and perform reasoning based on the retrieved knowledge. We further implement
this paradigm by introducing a new approach called Think-on-Graph (ToG), in
which the LLM agent iteratively executes beam search on KG, discovers the most
promising reasoning paths, and returns the most likely reasoning results. We use
a number of well-designed experiments to examine and illustrate the following

citations.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
citations.source_relative_path: Methods/191_Reasoning on Graphs Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning.pdf
citations.quote:
In this paper, we propose a novel method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs
with KGs to conduct faithful and interpretable reasoning. To alleviate the issues of hallucinations
and lack of knowledge, we present a planning-retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first gen-
erates relation paths grounded by KGs as faithful plans via the planning module. These plans are
then used to retrieve valid reasoning paths from KGs to conduct faithful reasoning by the retrieval-
reasoning module. In this way, we not only retrieve the latest knowledge from KGs but also consider

evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/191_Reasoning on Graphs Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning.pdf
evidence.quote:
In this paper, we propose a novel method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs
with KGs to conduct faithful and interpretable reasoning. To alleviate the issues of hallucinations
and lack of knowledge, we present a planning-retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first gen-
erates relation paths grounded by KGs as faithful plans via the planning module. These plans are
then used to retrieve valid reasoning paths from KGs to conduct faithful reasoning by the retrieval-
reasoning module. In this way, we not only retrieve the latest knowledge from KGs but also consider
the guidance of KG structure for reasoning and explanations. Moreover, the planning module of RoG
can be plug-and-play with different LLMs during inference to improve their performance. Based on
this framework, RoG is optimized by two tasks: 1) planning optimization, where we distill knowl-
edge from KGs into LLMs to generate faithful relation paths as plans; and 2) retrieval-reasoning
optimization, where we enable LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning based on retrieved paths and gen-
erate interpretable results. We conduct extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets,
and the results demonstrate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks
and generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results.
2

evidence.quote:
ABSTRACT
Although large language models (LLMs) have achieved significant success in vari-
ous tasks, they often struggle with hallucination problems, especially in scenarios
requiring deep and responsible reasoning. These issues could be partially addressed
by introducing external knowledge graphs (KG) in LLM reasoning. In this paper,
we propose a new LLM-KG integrating paradigm “LLM ⊗KG” which treats the
LLM as an agent to interactively explore related entities and relations on KGs
and perform reasoning based on the retrieved knowledge. We further implement
this paradigm by introducing a new approach called Think-on-Graph (ToG), in
which the LLM agent iteratively executes beam search on KG, discovers the most
promising reasoning paths, and returns the most likely reasoning results. We use
a number of well-designed experiments to examine and illustrate the following
advantages of ToG: 1) compared with LLMs, ToG has better deep reasoning power;
2) ToG has the ability of knowledge traceability and knowledge correctability by
leveraging LLMs reasoning and expert feedback; 3) ToG provides a flexible plug-
and-play framework for different LLMs, KGs and prompting strategies without
any additional training cost; 4) the performance of ToG with small LLM models
could exceed large LLM such as GPT-4 in certain scenarios and this reduces the
cost of LLM deployment and application. As a training-free method with lower
computational cost and better generality, ToG achieves overall SOTA in 6 out of
9 datasets where most previous SOTAs rely on additional training. Our code is
publicly available at https://github.com/IDEA-FinAI/ToG.

results.question: ToG 和 RoG 都利用 KG 推理，为什么不能据此把两者都归为免训练方法？分别追踪 KG 在在线搜索和训练中的作用。
results.answer: ToG 在 KG 上的在线作用：LLM 作为 agent 在 KG 上交互式探索实体和关系，迭代执行 beam search 找到推理路径 [chunk_e09b5a88c34014513aad6c0d6121f790]；作者称 ToG 是不需要额外训练成本的 plug-and-play 框架，且是 training-free prompting-based 方法 [chunk_e09b5a88c34014513aad6c0d6121f790][chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]。RoG 在训练中的作用：其规划模块通过“planning optimization”把 KG 中的知识蒸馏到 LLM 以生成关系路径作为计划，并通过“retrieval-reasoning optimization”让 LLM 基于检索路径推理 [chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21]；这说明 RoG 使用带优化/训练的框架 [chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21]。因此，不能仅因两者都利用 KG 推理就把两者都归为免训练方法：原文明确称 ToG 为 training-free [chunk_e09b5a88c34014513aad6c0d6121f790][chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]，而对 RoG 的描述是包含规划与检索-推理优化的框架 [chunk_8d1de153f62070216bf23df5989bda21]；但所给 RoG 证据未出现“免训练”判断，若问 RoG 是否免训练，现有证据不足。

results.question: 比较 ToG-2 与 LPKG：图知识分别怎样帮助文档证据检索和问题规划？说明二者发生在训练还是推理阶段。
results.answer: ToG-2 方面：原文称其通过知识图谱（KG）的引导实现深入且可靠的上下文检索，并把文档作为节点上下文进行精确的图检索，从而实现 KG 与文本 RAG 的紧耦合 [chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]；该框架被明确描述为 training-free、plug-and-play，可应用于多种 LLM [chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]，即没有训练阶段，运行于推理阶段。LPKG 方面：原文称其先利用 KG 中丰富的模式构建规划数据，再基于这些数据微调规划 LLM，使其能对下游数据执行规划，最终通过解析与执行得到答案 [chunk_cea61ca4533fd32e6f63ea730fb194ab]；其中提到“During the fine-tuning phase of planning LLMs” [chunk_cea61ca4533fd32e6f63ea730fb194ab]，说明图知识（KG）用于构造训练数据并进入规划 LLM 的微调，规划发生在推理时的下游任务。因此，ToG-2 的图知识在推理阶段引导文档证据检索，LPKG 的图知识先在训练阶段（微调）塑造规划能力、再于推理阶段用于问题规划。需注意：证据未提供二者在同一数据集、同一底座模型或同一指标协议下的比较，故不能据此判断二者检索/规划效果的优劣或公平胜负；ToG-2 的图路径使用属框架描述，具体检索流程证据以所引结论段为限。

results.question: G-Retriever 与 ToG-2 都用图帮助获取上下文，但它们选择证据的机制怎样不同？分别连接输入规模问题、相关子图选择以及实体和文档的协作。
results.answer: ToG-2 的流程是“利用知识图谱（KGs）通过实体链接文档，促进深度且知识引导的上下文检索；同时，它将文档作为实体上下文，以实现精确高效的图检索”，并与上下文检索交替进行 [chunk_9b63637ef18ed2d67ff105ef55092df3]；其摘要亦称“迭代地从非结构化与结构化知识源中以紧耦合方式检索信息” [chunk_9b63637ef18ed2d67ff105ef55092df3]。因此，就输入规模而言，ToG-2 处理的输入范围是 KG 与文档数据库，甚至可对纯文档库先抽取实体、再构图 [chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]；在相关子图选择上，ToG-2 将文档作为节点上下文来实现精确的图检索，而非独立的一次性子图选取 [chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]；实体与文档的协作方式是“KG 链接文档、文档作为实体上下文”，并让图检索与上下文检索交替进行 [chunk_9b63637ef18ed2d67ff105ef55092df3]。关于 G-Retriever，现有证据仅包含其性能结果表及效率结论，没有描述其证据选择机制、输入规模处理、相关子图选择或实体-文档协作流程；因此，无法据此核对它与 ToG-2 在上述三方面的机制差异，流程证据不足 [chunk_e2737c14a5cd36e6bd408af049fd0aac]。

results.question: G-Retriever 与 ToG-2 都用图帮助获取上下文，但它们选择证据的机制怎样不同？分别连接输入规模问题、相关子图选择以及实体和文档的协作。
results.answer: ToG-2 的选择机制被作者描述为“in-depth retrieval”：通过 KG 指导、把文档作为节点上下文来做精确图检索，实现 KG 与文本 RAG 的紧耦合 [chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]；其流程是先从问题抽取主题实体作为图搜索起点，每轮在 KG 上做关系检索扩展候选实体，并检索这些候选实体关联文档中的相关文本，再依据上下文检索结果剪枝候选实体、更新主题实体集作为下一轮起点 [chunk_fd05fc6099086f633f4ad41747c6caac]。每轮检索后让 LLM 基于获得的高相关三元组和上下文作答，若信息不足则继续下一轮检索 [chunk_fd05fc6099086f633f4ad41747c6caac]。对于输入规模问题，所给 ToG-2 证据只提到通过关系剪枝与主题剪枝来降低总 API 调用和运行时间，未给出输入规模的具体统计或定义 [chunk_ed6850570b5301d9c28d549903bb9f7b]。G-Retriever 的相关子图选择机制在提供的证据中没有方法描述，无法据此比较；现有 G-Retriever 引文仅报告数据集结果表和“检索后平均规模”的表头，不能用以推断检索流程或实体—文档协作方式 [chunk_e2737c14a5cd36e6bd408af049fd0aac]。因此，关于 G-Retriever 如何连接输入规模问题、相关子图选择以及实体与文档协作，流程证据不足。

results.question: 从 ToG 与 ToG-2 的评测段落出发，找出共同使用的 WebQSP 与 QALD10-en，分别给出“方法→数据集”的来源，再说明为什么这个连接不能证明优劣或继承。
results.answer: ToG 的评测段落明确将 QALD10-en 与 WebQSP 等列为实验数据集：原文称“Freebase … is used as KG for CWQ, WebQSP, GrailQA, Simple Questions, and Webquestions, and Wikidata … is used as KG for QALD10-en”，并报告“ToG with GPT-4 still achieves new SOTA performance in 6 out of 9 datasets, including WebQSP” [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]。ToG-2 的评测段落也列出 WebQSP 与 QALD-10-en：原文称“ToG-2 outperforms other baselines on WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en, and Zero-Shot RE”，并给出相对 ToG 的“4.93% on WebQSP, 3.85% on QALD-10-en”等提升 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]；其补充消融实验也写“across WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en and FEVER”并列出 WebQSP、QALD-10-en 的 EM 列 [chunk_031b7aaba8f20d011a94bb6a15b0f3b1]。这些证据只表明两篇论文都使用/报告了这两个数据集；它们没有给出可核对的相同数据划分、底座模型、指标或评测协议，因此“方法→数据集”的共同连接不能单独证明优劣或继承关系。ToG-2 文中确有相对 ToG 的提升表述，但这属于 ToG-2 的评测报告，而不是由“共同数据集”这一连接推出的结论 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]。

To evaluate the contribution of each component in ToG-2, we conducted comprehensive ablation
experiments across WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en and FEVER. To conserve API costs,
we sampled a small subset of the FEVER dataset for ablation experiments. Compared to the per-

brought relatively consistent improvements across each dataset, indicating that adaptive query opti-
mization can help the LLM better understand the tasks.

results.question: 从 ToG 与 ToG-2 的评测段落出发，找出共同使用的 WebQSP 与 QALD10-en，分别给出“方法→数据集”的来源，再说明为什么这个连接不能证明优劣或继承。
results.answer: ToG 在其评测段落中说明 Freebase 用于 CWQ、WebQSP 等数据集，而 Wikidata 用于 QALD10-en [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]；同一段列出 ToG 在 CWQ 和 WebQSP 上的不同主干结果表 [chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]。ToG-2 在评测段落报告其在 WebQSP、AdvHotpotQA、QALD-10-en 和 Zero-Shot RE 上优于其他基线，并称 WebQSP、AdvHotpotQA 和 QALD-10-en 是多跳推理数据集 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]；ToG-2 的补充消融实验也覆盖 WebQSP、AdvHotpotQA、QALD-10-en 和 FEVER [chunk_031b7aaba8f20d011a94bb6a15b0f3b1]。因此“方法→数据集”的来源是：ToG→WebQSP 及 QALD10-en（QALD10-en 使用 Wikidata）[chunk_270d9350248b566ed224ba5147a295a2]；ToG-2→WebQSP 与 QALD-10-en [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]。但共同数据集本身不能证明优劣或继承：ToG-2 只给出相对原始 ToG 的整体提升表述，并未在提供段落中说明与 ToG 相同的底座模型、数据划分、指标协议或 QALD10-en 的 KG 设置；ToG 段落对 QALD10-en 仅给出 Wikidata 作为 KG，未提供同条件对比结果。故这些连接只能说明两个方法都报告了这些数据集，不能据此推断性能胜负或方法继承；相关可比性证据不足。

results.answer: RoG 原文将 Freebase 定位为 KGQA 基准的“背景知识图谱”：其对 WebQSP 与 CWQ 的表述是“Freebase ... is the background knowledge graph for both datasets”。[chunk_229cb41ae3582cc199c9ee25c4956269] 同时，RoG 构造知识图谱统计表把 Freebase 与 Wiki-Movie 并列列出实体、关系和三元组数量，属于其“constructed knowledge graphs”之一。[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d] 关于 Wiki-Movies，RoG 原文说明“MetaQA-3hop dataset ... is based on Wiki-Movies KGs”，即 Wiki-Movies 是 MetaQA-3hop 所依托的知识图谱；该处只描述数据集来源，并给出从训练集选 1000 个样本。[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d] 但这一步是否就是 RoG 在 MetaQA 上的实验设置，原文该引句未直接说明，流程证据不足。[chunk_297df214042add51d3facf35d1934a3d] 比较两篇时，KG-GPT 的 MetaQA 结果表按 1-hop/2-hop/3-hop 报告 Hits@1，[chunk_3f7eb65828761447433c66c28ad111a4] 而所给 RoG 证据没有 MetaQA 指标数值或跳数结果；因此无法据这些原文做 RoG 与 KG-GPT 在 MetaQA 上的指标比较，缺失须明确。[chunk_3f7eb65828761447433c66c28ad111a4]

results.question: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 与 LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 怎样分别连接到知识来源？虽然都涉及 Wikidata，二者考察的关系推理能力有何区别？
results.answer: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 被原文描述为“contains challenging reasoning questions requiring access to two KGs”，即该数据集包含需要访问两个知识图谱的挑战性推理问题 [chunk_406249e1d98db3baa838606c7a974998]。LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 则被原文说明为“from a subset of Wikidata”构建，且“evenly covers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union types of questions” [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。因此，前者在原文中明确连接到两个 KG 的访问需求，后者明确连接到 Wikidata 子集，并考察多跳、比较、交集、并集四类问题 [chunk_406249e1d98db3baa838606c7a974998][chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。就所给证据而言，二者虽都涉及 Wikidata，但原文只支持 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 需要访问两个知识图谱、CLQA-Wiki 源自 Wikidata 子集并覆盖多跳/比较/交集/并集，未提供两者在其他关系推理维度上的直接对照，故无法进一步判定更细的能力差异 [chunk_406249e1d98db3baa838606c7a974998][chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。

results.question: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 与 LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 怎样分别连接到知识来源？虽然都涉及 Wikidata，二者考察的关系推理能力有何区别？
results.answer: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 是其为测试跨多个知识图谱推理而新建的数据集：论文称“to test the reasoning ability using multiple KGs, we create a new dataset, MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata, containing 109 questions that require reasoning with information from both MusicBrainz and Wikidata”，其中 MusicBrainz 是音乐领域的深度专业库，而 Wikidata 是一般知识库，因此二者分别对应"专业库+通用库"两个知识来源 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。该数据集由人工标注者按给定指令构造，用于寻找两个 KG 之间的推理路径 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 则取自 Wikidata 的一个子集：原文称“we construct a Comprehensive Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-set of Wikidata ... via grounding rich patterns”，其知识来源即 Wikidata [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。二者虽然都涉及 Wikidata，但所考察的关系推理能力不同：CLQA-Wiki 原文明确称“evenly covers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union types of questions”，并指出现有复杂 QA 基准“lack logical operations”，因此其考察的是包含逻辑运算的多跳、比较、交集与并集类型问题 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 则强调“requires reasoning with information from both MusicBrainz and Wikidata”，即需要跨两个知识图谱综合信息，并以跨 KG 推理路径为构造目标 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。原文未给出二者在同一推理能力维度上的对照实验，因此不能就强弱或胜负作比较。

citations.source_relative_path: Methods/018_Tree-of-Traversals A Zero-Shot Reasoning Algorithm for Augmenting Black-box Language Model.pdf
citations.quote:
MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata Dataset One novel
use-case of Tree-of-Traversals is synthesizing and
reasoning over multiple knowledge graph sources.
There is no existing dataset that requires synthesiz-
ing information from multiple KGs to answer indi-
vidual questions. Therefore, to test the reasoning
ability using multiple KGs, we create a new dataset,
MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata, containing 109 questions
that require reasoning with information from both
MusicBrainz and Wikidata. Unlike Wikidata which
contains general knowledge, MusicBrainz is a deep
domain-specific database on the music industry.
The vast majority of this information is unlikely to
be known by large language models. We construct
the MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata dataset with human
annotators who were provided with instructions
to find reasoning paths between these two KGs,
the question types to focus on, and some example
questions.

Additionally, we construct a Comprehensive
Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-
set of Wikidata (Vrandecic and Krötzsch, 2014) via
grounding rich patterns as aforementioned. Exist-
ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho
et al., 2020; Press et al., 2023; Trivedi et al., 2022)
primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type
questions and lack logical operations. Furthermore,
most questions are labeled with only one answer,
whereas in reality, they often have multiple correct
answers. The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly cov-
ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive
and challenging for complex QA evaluation.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
(1) We introduce a novel framework LPKG that
enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-
mark, named CLQA-Wiki, to more effectively as-
sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA
tasks; (3) Our proposed framework LPKG achieves
better results than popular baselines on multiple
conventional complex QA benchmarks, and we
verify the effectiveness of the introduction of KG-
sourced planning data.

results.question: HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 与 ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 是什么关系？引用两篇的设置说明，判断能否直接用结果数字比较两种检索方法。
results.answer: 证据不足以判定关系：ToG-2 的设置说明只把 AdvHotpotQA 列为多跳推理数据集，并报告 ToG-2 在该数据集上相对 ToG 提升 16.6% [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]；该设置说明未提到 HippoRAG，也未说明 AdvHotpotQA 由 HotpotQA 如何构造 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]。HippoRAG 的设置说明显示其在 HotpotQA 上评测，并称在“less challenging HotpotQA”上达到可比性能 [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]；其指标包括检索 R@2/R@5 和 QA 的 EM/F1 [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]。直接比较数字方面：现有证据未给出 AdvHotpotQA 与 HotpotQA 的构造、数据划分或评测协议对应关系，也未说明两者使用相同底座模型、提示与指标口径，因此不能仅凭结果数字直接比较两种检索方法 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821][chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]；需先核对数据划分、底座模型、指标和协议，缺项即不可比 [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]。

results.question: HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 与 ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 是什么关系？引用两篇的设置说明，判断能否直接用结果数字比较两种检索方法。
results.answer: 两篇文献都没有在给定证据中明确说明 HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 与 ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 之间的数据集版本或构建关系：ToG-2 仅称 AdvHotpotQA 为多跳推理数据集 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]，HippoRAG 仅把 HotpotQA 称为“less challenging HotpotQA dataset” [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]，因此无法据这些引句判定二者是同一数据划分或可直接对应。HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 报告使用 recall@2/recall@5 与 QA 的 EM/F1，并用同一 QA reader 比较 [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765][chunk_d374bd95d509d622be8512f20e59b674]；ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 结果按不同底座模型与 Direct 基线报告百分比提升 [chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]，且文中还提到以 EM 评估时存在较多 false negatives [chunk_a5be5bd1049658e91cbad5ab416957de]。这些设置说明不足以证明两种检索方法在同一 HotpotQA/AdvHotpotQA 条件、同一指标协议和同一底座模型下可比，因此不能直接用两者的结果数字比较；缺少数据集划分与统一评测协议的对应说明，流程证据不足。

evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/191_Reasoning on Graphs Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning.pdf
evidence.quote:
A.5
BASELINES
We compare RoG with 21 baselines grouping into 5 categories: 1) Embedding-based methods, 2)
Retrieval-augmented methods, 3) Semantic parsing methods, 4) LLMs, and 5) LLMs+KGs methods.
The details of each baseline are described as follows.
Embedding-based methods.
• KV-Mem (Miller et al., 2016) adopts a Key-Value memory network to store triples and
perform multi-hop reasoning by iterative operating on the memory.
• EmbedKGQA (Saxena et al., 2020) models the reasoning on KGs as a sequential link pre-
diction problem by using the embedding of entities and questions.
• NSM (He et al., 2021) utilizes the sequential model to mimic the multi-hop reasoning
process.
• TransferNet (Shi et al., 2021) adopts a graph neural network to capture the relevance be-
tween entities and questions for reasoning.
• KGT5 (Saxena et al., 2022) finetunes a sequence-to-sequence framework on KGs and gen-
erates answers based on the input question.
Retrieval-augmented methods.
• GraftNet (Sun et al., 2018) retrieves relevant subgraphs from KGs with entity linking.
• PullNet (Sun et al., 2019) trains a retrieval model composed of a LSTM and a graph neural
network to retrieve a question-specific subgraph.

evidence.quote:
Conclusion
We suggest KG-GPT, a versatile framework that
utilizes LLMs for tasks that use KGs. KG-GPT is
divided into three stages: Sentence Segmentation,
Graph Retrieval, and Inference, each designed for
breaking down sentences, sourcing related graph
elements, and reaching reasoned outcomes, respec-
tively. We assess KG-GPT’s efficacy using KG-
based fact verification and KGQA metrics, and
the model demonstrates consistent, impressive re-
sults, even surpassing a number of fully-supervised
models. Consequently, our research signifies a sub-
stantial advancement in combining structured and
unstructured data management in the LLMs’ con-
text.

entity from the original sentence all at once.

We suggest KG-GPT, a versatile framework that
utilizes LLMs for tasks that use KGs. KG-GPT is
divided into three stages: Sentence Segmentation,

the model demonstrates consistent, impressive re-

stantial advancement in combining structured and
unstructured data management in the LLMs’ con-
text.

BASELINES
We compare RoG with 21 baselines grouping into 5 categories: 1) Embedding-based methods, 2)
Retrieval-augmented methods, 3) Semantic parsing methods, 4) LLMs, and 5) LLMs+KGs methods.
The details of each baseline are described as follows.
Embedding-based methods.
• KV-Mem (Miller et al., 2016) adopts a Key-Value memory network to store triples and

• EmbedKGQA (Saxena et al., 2020) models the reasoning on KGs as a sequential link pre-

• NSM (He et al., 2021) utilizes the sequential model to mimic the multi-hop reasoning

results.question: 在 ToG、HippoRAG 与 RoG 中，分别找出“LLM 逐步探索图”“查询种子驱动图算法”“先规划关系路径再取证”的方法。每项给出一篇原文，并比较多跳关联发生在哪一步。
results.answer: ToG 对应“LLM 逐步探索图”：原文以工作流图说明搜索按迭代（深度）从中心实体开始，并由 LLM 对边评分、剪枝，最终汇集 beam search 的 top-N 推理路径 [chunk_b160799030dcc4aeb6145d3dd00db7f3]。HippoRAG 的给定摘要只说明受大脑关联记忆启发，让 LLM 构建并利用关联图来做知识整合，并批评现有多步 RAG 迭代检索的不足；它没有给出“查询种子驱动图算法”的具体流程，方法证据不足 [chunk_d32e1706909cc088dae124d6b0f3893c]。RoG 对应“先规划关系路径再取证”：原文说 planning module 旨在生成“忠实关系路径”作为回答问题的计划，并把规划优化与检索-推理优化合并为最终目标 [chunk_482ad8a6ae6b59dc872a9f742d9050ed]。比较多跳关联发生步骤：ToG 在图搜索迭代中由 LLM 逐步选择/剪枝并汇集多跳路径 [chunk_b160799030dcc4aeb6145d3dd00db7f3]；RoG 先在规划模块生成关系路径，再基于检索到的推理路径进行推理 [chunk_482ad8a6ae6b59dc872a9f742d9050ed]；HippoRAG 缺少可核对的步骤描述，无法就“查询种子驱动图算法”的关联步骤与其他两者比较 [chunk_d32e1706909cc088dae124d6b0f3893c]。

results.question: 在 ToG、HippoRAG 与 RoG 中，分别找出“LLM 逐步探索图”“查询种子驱动图算法”“先规划关系路径再取证”的方法。每项给出一篇原文，并比较多跳关联发生在哪一步。
results.answer: ToG：原文说明“At each pruning step, the darkness of the edges represents the ranking score given by LLM”，并称 ToG 从KG抽取多跳推理路径作为LLM推理基础；图上的多跳关联在“Think”步逐步探索时发生（搜索、剪枝与束搜索收集路径）[chunk_b160799030dcc4aeb6145d3dd00db7f3]。HippoRAG：原文仅强调让LLM构建并利用“a similar graph of associations”以应对知识整合，并指出现有RAG需多轮检索与生成步骤；现有证据未描述“查询种子驱动图算法”的具体流程，故该方法的图算法证据不足[chunk_d32e1706909cc088dae124d6b0f3893c]。RoG：原文明言“planning module aims to generate faithful relation paths as plans”，并与检索-推理目标联合优化；因此多跳关联先在规划模块生成关系路径（计划），之后再做检索-推理取证[chunk_482ad8a6ae6b59dc872a9f742d9050ed]。

ToG-2 通过“把文档作为节点上下文（treating documents as node contexts）”来连接图与文档，并借助 KG 指导进行“in-depth retrieval”。[chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2] 它“使用检索到的异质知识作为 LLM 推理的基础（using retrieved heterogeneous knowledge as the basis for LLM reasoning）”。[chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2] 其目标是紧密耦合 KG-based RAG 与 text-based RAG，从而同时实现“深度上下文检索与精确图检索（in-depth context retrieval and precise graph retrieval）”。[chunk_529e795e797b26de48cdc1fe5cbea79c] 结论段也描述了“KG×Text RAG”框架，它“使用文本上下文实现可靠的图检索、通过 KG 实现知识引导的上下文检索，并迭代执行协同检索（reliable graph retrieval by using textual contexts, achieves knowledge-guided context retrieval via the KG, and iteratively perform a cooperative retrieval process）”。[chunk_44ca1868cc8294f6cfe2d5991cbd0d4b]

HippoRAG 的摘要称其协同编排“LLMs、知识图谱和 Personalized PageRank 算法（LLMs, knowledge graphs, and the Personalized PageRank algorithm）”。[chunk_59677fe889f95e3e84ca00ba132a54fd] 因此，图与文档之间的节点—文档映射细节、以及检索最终如何回到支持证据的逐步流程（例如文档段落如何作为证据返回），在所提供的摘要证据中未展开；流程证据不足。[chunk_59677fe889f95e3e84ca00ba132a54fd]

KGP 未被所提供的任何证据提及；因此无法说明其图—文档连接方式或检索回到支持证据的流程，比较证据缺失。[chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]（指出缺口所依据的是整体证据集无 KGP，而非某条引句。）

CONCLUSION
Existing RAG systems based on KGs or texts struggle to ensure in-depth knowledge retrieval
when dealing with complex knowledge reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce a hybrid RAG
paradigm, KG×Text RAG, which tightly couples KG-based and text-based RAG, and propose the
Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2) algorithmic framework that enables reliable graph retrieval by using
textual contexts, achieves knowledge-guided context retrieval via the KG, and iteratively perform a
cooperative retrieval process to obtain in-depth knowledge for achieving deep and faithful LLM rea-
soning. Experimental results demonstrate that ToG-2 can significantly improve LLMs of different
sizes and outperform existing various LLM reasoning methods and RAG methods without additional

evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/035_HippoRAG Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models.pdf
evidence.quote:
Abstract
In order to thrive in hostile and ever-changing natural environments, mammalian
brains evolved to store large amounts of knowledge about the world and continually
integrate new information while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Despite their
impressive accomplishments, large language models (LLMs), even with retrieval-
augmented generation (RAG), still struggle to efficiently and effectively integrate
a large amount of new experiences after pre-training. In this work, we introduce
HippoRAG, a novel retrieval framework inspired by the hippocampal indexing
theory of human long-term memory to enable deeper and more efficient knowledge
integration over new experiences. HippoRAG synergistically orchestrates LLMs,
knowledge graphs, and the Personalized PageRank algorithm to mimic the different
roles of neocortex and hippocampus in human memory. We compare HippoRAG
with existing RAG methods on multi-hop question answering (QA) and show that
our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods remarkably, by up to 20%.
Single-step retrieval with HippoRAG achieves comparable or better performance
than iterative retrieval like IRCoT while being 10-20 times cheaper and 6-13 times
faster, and integrating HippoRAG into IRCoT brings further substantial gains.
Finally, we show that our method can tackle new types of scenarios that are out of
reach of existing methods.1

evidence.title: Think-on-Graph 2.0: Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
evidence.quote:
The most relevant works to ToG-2 are hybrid RAG approaches that aim to integrate both KGs and un-
structured data with LLM, leveraging the strengths of both to mitigate their respective weaknesses.
Chain-of-Knowledge (Li et al., 2024c) (CoK) is a hybrid RAG method that retrieves knowledge
from Wikipedia, Wikidata and Wikitable to ground LLMs’ outputs. GraphRAG (Edge et al., 2024)
establishes a KG from documents and enables KG-enhanced text retrieval. HybridRAG (Sarmah
et al., 2024) retrieves information from both vector databases and KGs, achieving superior reason-
ing performance compared to either text-based RAG or KG-based RAG methods alone. However,
existing hybrid RAG approaches merely aggregate information retrieved from KGs and texts but do
not improve the retrieval results on one knowledge source through the other. In this work, ToG-2
aims to tightly couple KG-based RAG and text-based RAG methods, enabling both in-depth context
retrieval and precise graph retrieval to enhance complex reasoning performances of LLMs.

brains evolved to store large amounts of knowledge about the world and continually
integrate new information while avoiding catastrophic forgetting. Despite their
impressive accomplishments, large language models (LLMs), even with retrieval-
augmented generation (RAG), still struggle to efficiently and effectively integrate
a large amount of new experiences after pre-training. In this work, we introduce
HippoRAG, a novel retrieval framework inspired by the hippocampal indexing
theory of human long-term memory to enable deeper and more efficient knowledge
integration over new experiences. HippoRAG synergistically orchestrates LLMs,
knowledge graphs, and the Personalized PageRank algorithm to mimic the different
roles of neocortex and hippocampus in human memory. We compare HippoRAG
with existing RAG methods on multi-hop question answering (QA) and show that
our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods remarkably, by up to 20%.
Single-step retrieval with HippoRAG achieves comparable or better performance
than iterative retrieval like IRCoT while being 10-20 times cheaper and 6-13 times
faster, and integrating HippoRAG into IRCoT brings further substantial gains.
Finally, we show that our method can tackle new types of scenarios that are out of
reach of existing methods.1

evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
evidence.quote:
The most relevant works to ToG-2 are hybrid RAG approaches that aim to integrate both KGs and un-
structured data with LLM, leveraging the strengths of both to mitigate their respective weaknesses.
Chain-of-Knowledge (Li et al., 2024c) (CoK) is a hybrid RAG method that retrieves knowledge
from Wikipedia, Wikidata and Wikitable to ground LLMs’ outputs. GraphRAG (Edge et al., 2024)
establishes a KG from documents and enables KG-enhanced text retrieval. HybridRAG (Sarmah
et al., 2024) retrieves information from both vector databases and KGs, achieving superior reason-
ing performance compared to either text-based RAG or KG-based RAG methods alone. However,
existing hybrid RAG approaches merely aggregate information retrieved from KGs and texts but do
not improve the retrieval results on one knowledge source through the other. In this work, ToG-2
aims to tightly couple KG-based RAG and text-based RAG methods, enabling both in-depth context
retrieval and precise graph retrieval to enhance complex reasoning performances of LLMs.

evidence.quote:
CONCLUSION
Existing RAG systems based on KGs or texts struggle to ensure in-depth knowledge retrieval
when dealing with complex knowledge reasoning tasks. In this work, we introduce a hybrid RAG
paradigm, KG×Text RAG, which tightly couples KG-based and text-based RAG, and propose the
Think-on-Graph 2.0 (ToG-2) algorithmic framework that enables reliable graph retrieval by using
textual contexts, achieves knowledge-guided context retrieval via the KG, and iteratively perform a
cooperative retrieval process to obtain in-depth knowledge for achieving deep and faithful LLM rea-
soning. Experimental results demonstrate that ToG-2 can significantly improve LLMs of different
sizes and outperform existing various LLM reasoning methods and RAG methods without additional
training costs.

results.question: 围绕“有限上下文或有限搜索预算下如何保留必要证据”，比较 G-Retriever、Tree-of-Traversals 与 CuriousLLM 的机制。哪些是子图选择，哪些是搜索边界，哪些是证据缺口信号？
results.answer: 按原文，G-Retriever 将检索明确表述为“子图选择”：它把“subgraph retrieval”构造为 PCST 优化问题，并构建“connected subgraph”以覆盖尽可能多的相关节点和边，同时保持可管理的图规模 [chunk_2da94a87e97c2e0f30e8eec5659e202d]。Tree-of-Traversals 的机制则是维护并反复扩展一个“local KG subgraph”，直到该子图包含回答查询所需的信息后停止；这个停止条件同时起到搜索边界的作用 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]。CuriousLLM 的原文给出的是基于 KG 的遍历流程：在预设 passage budget K 下从种子段落开始遍历，并且当遍历代理返回空集时终止循环 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]；此外，它还用终止信号“NA”表示已收集足够证据，从而实现提前终止 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]。就可归类的证据缺口信号而言，CuriousLLM 的“NA”终止信号是原文中最直接的信号；Tree-of-Traversals 的“本地子图包含回答所需信息”是停止条件，原文没有把它表述为缺口信号；G-Retriever 的原文只描述了子图选择与可管理规模，未给出证据缺口信号 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521][chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8][chunk_2da94a87e97c2e0f30e8eec5659e202d]。关于三者在“有限上下文或有限搜索预算下如何保留必要证据”上的可比效果，现有证据不足以作比较：CuriousLLM 只说明提前终止减少遍历时间并维持竞争性准确率，G-Retriever 只说明子图覆盖相关节点边并保持可管理规模，Tree-of-Traversals 只说明本地子图扩展到可回答即停；三者缺少同一协议下的预算与保留证据指标对照 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521][chunk_2da94a87e97c2e0f30e8eec5659e202d][chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]。

The Tree-of-Traversals algorithm maintains a local
KG subgraph that is repeatedly expanded until it
contains all the information required by an LLM
to answer the given query. At the start, a local
KG subgraph is initialized to contain the entities
present in the original query. It is then expanded
using a tree search algorithm to choose actions and
thoughts generated by an LLM in order to obtain
relevant knowledge from the KG using a KG inter-
face. The algorithm halts when the LLM is able
to answer the original query using the local KG
subgraph as context.

5
G-Retriever
In this section, we introduce G-Retriever, a new architecture tailored for GraphQA, which integrates
the strengths of GNNs, LLMs, and RAG. To allow efficient fine-tuning while preserving the LLM’s
pretrained language capabilities, we freeze the LLM and use a soft prompting approach on the output
of the GNN. Our RAG-based design mitigates hallucinations through direct retrieval of the graph,
while allowing our approach to scale to graphs exceeding the LLM’s context window size. To adapt
RAG to graphs, we formulate subgraph retrieval as a PCST optimization problem. This approach
also allows us to enhance explainability by returning the retrieved subgraph.
G-Retriever comprises four main steps: indexing, retrieval, subgraph construction and generation, as
depicted in Figure 3. The implementation details of each step are elaborated in the following sections.
5.1
Indexing

The Tree-of-Traversals algorithm maintains a local

three major components. (1) A knowledge graph
interface implemented to interact with one or more

results.answer: 在有限预算下保留证据的机制比较中，Tree-of-Traversals 明确维护并反复扩展一个局部 KG 子图，直到该子图包含回答所需信息，并在 LLM 能用该局部子图作答时停止 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]；这属于子图选择，同时其树搜索组件定义了搜索轨迹、回溯和终止条件，因而也是搜索边界 [chunk_0cb3c2dcbacf18237a13b232366d2be8]。CuriousLLM 用预设 passage budget K 约束遍历，并在遍历代理返回空集合时终止循环 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]；它还训练模型在证据足够时生成终止信号，从而提前结束搜索 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]。因此 CuriousLLM 的预算与终止机制属于搜索边界，其“证据足够”终止信号可视为证据缺口关闭信号，但其子图选择流程在给定引文中证据不足 [chunk_1c31546f7f4375c1f684f59dc4fa0521]。G-Retriever 的机制证据在给定引文中不足：现有引文只有结果表和效率表附近文字，无法据表推断其检索流程或子图选择机制 [chunk_e2737c14a5cd36e6bd408af049fd0aac]。

results.answer: 三类训练信号与用途可分属如下。图派生规划数据属于 LPKG：其框架“utilizes the rich patterns in the KGs to construct planning data, then fine-tune planning LLMs based on such data”[chunk_cea61ca4533fd32e6f63ea730fb194ab]。问题与支持证据生成追问属于 CuriousLLM：Follow-upQA“includes questions and supporting evidence as input, with follow-up questions serving as ground truths”，且该机制让 agent“generate relevant follow-up questions”以引导检索[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。KG 支持的关系路径属于 RoG：RoG“first generates relation paths grounded by KGs as faithful plans”，这些计划再用于从 KG 检索有效推理路径[chunk_58e7ae48fdb49536bc066f6e74ccd2a0]。就推理用途看，RoG 的关系路径用于检索并支持忠实推理[chunk_58e7ae48fdb49536bc066f6e74ccd2a0]；LPKG 的规划数据用于微调规划 LLM 以在下游数据集上规划并执行得答案[chunk_cea61ca4533fd32e6f63ea730fb194ab]；CuriousLLM 的追问用于引导信息检索[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]。

ABSTRACT
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abili-
ties in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience
hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes
and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs),
which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source
of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning
methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance
of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel
method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to
enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-
retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded
by KGs as faithful plans.

ABSTRACT
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abili-
ties in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience
hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes
and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs),
which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source
of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning
methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance
of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel
method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to
enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-
retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded
by KGs as faithful plans. These plans are then used to retrieve valid reasoning
paths from the KGs for LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning. Furthermore, RoG
not only distills knowledge from KGs to improve the reasoning ability of LLMs
through training but also allows seamless integration with any arbitrary LLMs dur-
ing inference. Extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets demon-
strate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks and
generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results1.

evidence.quote:
Abstract
Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved
significant success in open-domain question an-
swering. However, they continue to face chal-
lenges such as hallucinations and knowledge
cutoffs. These issues can be mitigated through
in-context learning by providing LLMs with
relevant context before generating answers.
Recent literature proposes Knowledge Graph
Prompting (KGP) which integrates knowledge
graphs with an LLM-based traversal agent
to substantially enhance document retrieval
quality. However, KGP requires costly fine-
tuning with large datasets and remains prone
to hallucination. In this paper, we propose
CuriousLLM, an enhancement that integrates
a curiosity-driven reasoning mechanism into
an LLM agent. This mechanism enables the
agent to generate relevant follow-up questions,
thereby guiding the information retrieval pro-
cess more efficiently. Central to our approach
is the development of the new Follow-upQA
dataset, which includes questions and support-
ing evidence as input, with follow-up ques-
tions serving as ground truths. These follow-
up questions either inquire about what is still
missing to fully answer the user’s query or
use special tokens to signify that the retrieved
evidence is sufficient. Our experiments show
that CuriousLLM significantly boosts LLM per-
formance in multi-document question answer-
ing (MD-QA), circumventing the substantial
computational costs and latency from the orig-
inal KGP framework. Source code: https:
//github.com/zukangy/KGP-CuriousLLM.

citations.quote:
ABSTRACT
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abili-
ties in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience
hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes
and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs),
which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source
of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning
methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance
of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel
method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to
enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-
retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded
by KGs as faithful plans.

In our view, the limitations of our work at the cur-
rent stage mainly stem from two aspects:

yet explored the impact of question type distribu-

the focus of future work.

types of questions (multi-hop, comparison, and
union/intersection), but in reality, some question
types may be implicit or even not be included in
the types we define. The future direction of our
work can be to study planning methods for these
types of unclear questions.

results.question: ToG/ToG-R 的搜索宽度和深度怎样联系到 LLM 调用次数？再与 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度、扩展预算对照，说明为什么这些公式/上限不能直接换算成统一运行时排名。
results.answer: ToG 的深度与宽度设定与性能：实验覆盖深度 1–4、宽度 1–4，且性能随搜索深度和宽度提高；计算成本随深度线性增加，因此默认把深度和宽度都设为 3 [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]。ToG-R 的 LLM 调用上界：原文明确给出“ToG-R needs at most ND + D + 1 calls to the LLM” [chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]。ToG 的 LLM 调用次数公式：所给证据没有给出 ToG 的调用次数公式，只说明其计算成本随深度线性增加并采用默认 D、N [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]；因此 ToG 与 ToG-R 调用公式的完整对照证据不足。Tree-of-Traversals 的深度与扩展预算：所给证据只有结论性陈述，称其为无需示例、无模式依赖、无需训练的 KG 推理算法 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]；没有给出深度、扩展预算或 LLM 调用次数上限的定义，故无法与 ToG/ToG-R 的公式逐项对照。关于换算为统一运行时排名：证据不足以支持直接换算或排名——ToG 的成本表述是随深度线性增加且 D、N 为默认实验设置 [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]，ToG-R 给出的是 ND+D+1 的调用上界 [chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]，Tree-of-Traversals 一侧缺少对应的深度/扩展预算与调用计数描述 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]；因此这些公式或上限不能凭现有证据直接换算成统一的运行时排名。

Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.

results.question: ToG/ToG-R 的搜索宽度和深度怎样联系到 LLM 调用次数？再与 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度、扩展预算对照，说明为什么这些公式/上限不能直接换算成统一运行时排名。
results.answer: ToG/ToG-R 的深度与宽度直接决定 LLM 调用次数上限：原文给出 ToG 的理论最大复杂度为 2ND + D + 1，ToG-R 为至多 ND + D + 1 次 LLM 调用 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783][chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]。但作者同时指出，这是最大复杂度，实际通常会提前停止，因此多数情况下并不需要达到该上限 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]。作者还称计算成本随深度线性增加，并把深度和宽度默认设为 3 [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]。关于 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度与扩展预算如何设定，所给证据只说明它是无需示例、不依赖 schema、无需训练的算法 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]，没有给出可与其对照的深度或扩展预算公式，因此无法完成该换算对照，流程证据不足。综上，ToG/ToG-R 的公式描述的是该方法的 LLM 调用上界，而 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度与预算证据缺失，不能据此把两类上限直接换算成统一的运行时排名。

results.question: 结合 LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 与 Tree-of-Traversals 的 2Wiki/MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 描述，区分“多跳”“交并逻辑”“跨 KG”三种任务关系，并逐项绑定到相应证据。
results.answer: LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 被描述为从 Wikidata 子集构建、覆盖多跳、比较、交集和并集类型问题，并指出已有复杂 QA 基准主要聚焦多跳与比较类且缺少逻辑操作 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 被描述为需要同时使用 MusicBrainz 与 Wikidata 两个知识图谱的信息进行推理的新数据集 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。关于 2Wiki，证据只说明在 2WikiMultiHop 任务上评估并使用 Wikidata 作为知识图谱 [chunk_bc1cd12431f46892d2877dff73dab5e5]，未给出其任务关系属于“多跳/交并/跨KG”的分类描述，因此不能据此把 2Wiki 绑定为多跳或跨KG [chunk_db3f4b0797f0910ec556e6c6930ef07b]。按上述描述可绑定：多跳与交并逻辑由 CLQA-Wiki 的覆盖范围证据支持 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]；跨KG由 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 的“多KG来源推理”证据支持 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。2Wiki 的具体任务关系在上述证据中不足，需说明缺口 [chunk_db3f4b0797f0910ec556e6c6930ef07b]。

citations.quote:
MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata Dataset One novel
use-case of Tree-of-Traversals is synthesizing and
reasoning over multiple knowledge graph sources.
There is no existing dataset that requires synthesiz-
ing information from multiple KGs to answer indi-
vidual questions. Therefore, to test the reasoning
ability using multiple KGs, we create a new dataset,
MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata, containing 109 questions
that require reasoning with information from both
MusicBrainz and Wikidata. Unlike Wikidata which

results.question: 结合 LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 与 Tree-of-Traversals 的 2Wiki/MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 描述，区分“多跳”“交并逻辑”“跨 KG”三种任务关系，并逐项绑定到相应证据。
results.answer: LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 被描述为“evenly covers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union types of questions”，即“多跳”与“交并”在该基准中是并列覆盖的题型，而非同一种任务关系 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 说明其用途是面向多 KG 来源进行推理：“synthesizing and reasoning over multiple knowledge graph sources”，并称此前没有需要综合多个 KG 信息回答单个问题的数据集，故新建该数据集 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。关于 2Wiki，提供的证据只显示其被列为问答任务之一 [chunk_db3f4b0797f0910ec556e6c6930ef07b]，并在实现细节中说明“For 2WikiMultiHop and QALD-10, we use Wikidata as the knowledge graph” [chunk_bc1cd12431f46892d2877dff73dab5e5]；因此“2Wiki”在所述实验中是单 KG（Wikidata）设置，证据不足以把它绑定为“跨 KG”关系。综合三项：多跳与交并是 CLQA-Wiki 的题型维度 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]；跨 KG 由 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 明示要求同时使用两个 KG 推理 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]；2Wiki 仅可绑定到 Wikidata 单 KG 的使用说明，不能据现有证据断言其涉及跨 KG 或交并逻辑 [chunk_bc1cd12431f46892d2877dff73dab5e5]。
